On Season 1, Episode 9 of the Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Big Bang Theory fans get two stacked conversations about “Spoiler: We Couldn’t Get Green Lantern.” Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton welcome Kyle and Trevor actors Ryan Cartwright and Josh Brener, followed by creators Chuck Lorre, Zak Penn and Bill Prady alongside DC president, publisher and chief creative officer Jim Lee.

This is pure fan access to the show’s comic book universe.
